Help in the research of a new skill by collecting artifacts from [[Orr]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
 |campaign = Prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Collect [5..0] more [[Orrian Tablet Shard|Orrian tablet shards]].
* Return to [[Magi Malaquire]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 400 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
Head outside into [[North Kryta Province]] and follow the quest marker to the northeast corner of the map. Alternatively, you can start from [[Gates of Kryta (outpost)|Gates of Kryta]] for a shorter trip through [[Scoundrel's Rise]], which connects to North Kryta Province very close to where you need to go.

The area marked on the map is only accessible from the sea. There is a path in the cliff that can be entered from a sand bank in front of the shore, to the east of the beach. Usually there is a group of Mergoyles around the beach.

When you head up the hill, you'll be faced with a relatively large group of [[Enchanted Clay]]. They shouldn't be too difficult to kill, and using [[AoE]] skills will make it significantly easier.

Once they're all defeated, you'll find they'll have dropped 20 [[Orrian Tablet Shard]]s in total, not just the 5 you need to complete this quest. As long as you pick up the five you need, you don't need any more: you won't get an extra reward for it. Once you've collected what you need, head back to [[Magi Malaquire]] to collect your reward.

==NPCs==
*{{x}} 10 (24) [[Enchanted Clay]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Magi Malaquire
:''I am known to mortal men as Magi Malaquire. I have been researching new methods in skill acquisition. Such a task is effortless to one such as I, of course, but I lack one final ingredient. Long ago, ancient tablets were brought here from Orr by wizards of some consequence. They were buried in '''[[North Kryta Province]]''', where their magic seeped into the very earth. I sent villagers to excavate these tablets for me, but alas, they unearthed only magical beings made of clay. I believe that these enchanted clay creatures hold shards of the Orrian tablets within themselves. I need heroes such as you to defeat these creatures and return to me the '''[[Orrian Tablet Shard|Orrian tablet shard]]s''' contained within. Bring me 5 shards that I may continue my research.''

:''You will of course accept this task?''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Of course.
| decline = I think you can handle it.
| ask = Bring to me '''5 Orrian tablet shards'''. They can be found inside the enchanted clay located in '''North Kryta Province'''.
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Magi Malaquire
:''Thank you! these shards are very important to my research. Now leave me to my work. Soon all will be revealed.''

==Notes==
* Upon completion, Magi Malaquire will take ''all'' the shards in your inventory. If you wish to keep any extras, put them in storage or give them to a different character first.
